 Find out all you need to know about the telecast and livestream of the SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal match between Bangladesh and Pakistan.

 Bangladesh easily got past Sri Lanka as it won 4-0 with impressive performances from its midfielders. Pakistan comes into the semifinal after a 3-0 win over Maldives.
 | Photo Credit: bangladeshfootballfederation/X
 Bangladesh will look to extend its upturn in form when it takes on Pakistan in the second semifinal of the SAFF Championship 2026 in Dhaka on Saturday.
 FOLLOW LIVE | BANGLADESH VS PAKISTAN LIVE SCORE, SAFF CHAMPIONSHIP SEMIFINAL 
 After edging past Bhutan in its opening match, Bangladesh produced a dominant display against Sri Lanka in its final group-stage fixture, cruising to a 4-0 victory. Pakistan, meanwhile, lost its opening match to India before bouncing back with a convincing 3-0 win over the Maldives.
 With a place in the final at stake, the semifinal promises to be a closely fought contest, with both sides looking for individual brilliance to break the deadlock.
 When will the Bangladesh vs Pakistan SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal match kick off? 
 The Bangladesh vs Pakistan SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal match will kick off at 8 p.m. IST on Saturday, November 14. Match will start at 7.30 p.m. Pakistan time and 8.30 p.m. Bangladesh time.
 Where to watch the Bangladesh vs Pakistan SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal match? 
 The Bangladesh vs Pakistan SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal match will be played at the National Stadium in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
 Where to watch the Bangladesh vs Pakistan SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal match? 
 The Bangladesh vs Pakistan SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal match will be livestreamed on the Veto app.
